node.label: Sleep onset insomnia
node.definition: Difficulty initiating sleep, that is, increased sleep onset latency, refers to the condition where it takes 30 minutes or more to fall asleep.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis, type IIID: Sleep onset insomnia (frequency 1/3) [PCS]
